dct_description_sm: This project focused on building the adaptive capacity within First Nations governments and communities in response to climate change and on promoting proactive policy. The main objectives of the project were: (1) to provide a link between Yukon communities and territorial/national levels of climate change policy development and discussion; (2) to assist in the development of regional and community-based adaptation plans, including risk assessment, land use planning, and climate change scenarios; (3) to assist communities with climate change project proposals; (4) to ensure that Yukon First Nation communities have access to adequate information about climate change programs and initiatives; (5) to promote partnerships on policy related to climate change and all of its activities regionally, nationally, and internationally; (6) to continue to identify local knowledge gaps on the subject of climate change; (7) to contribute local and traditional knowledge to regional and national forums on climate change; and (8) to introduce climate change adaptation tools and strategies by developing presentations and communication materials on subjects such as risk assessment and climate change scenarios in order to help in the analysis and development of adaptation strategies at the community level.
